Your New Role … The Staff Product Manager is responsible for CNN Newsource; the ideal candidate is able to envision our offering standing out amongst news agencies not by competing on the same terms as the wire services, but by building a fundamentally better product experience anchored in video and driven by deep understanding of what our partners need. This role is about turning that vis ion , grounded in deep user and business understanding, into a product strategy, a roadmap, and measurable business results. CNN Newsource is CNN’s B2B content syndication service, partnering with 1,000+ news organizations to deliver video, text, and photo content across platforms. Leveraging CNN’s global newsgathering, 24/7 distribution, and leading video capabilities, this role focuses on improving how partners discover, access, and use content—making it easier to integrate into workflows and better understand audience engagement. Your Role Accountabilities … Own the product vision, strategy, goals, and roadmap for the digital experience that CNN Newsource delivers to its partner network. Identify and prioritize product investments based on customer impact and business value, and develop data-informed recommendations on where to increase or decrease investment. Build your knowledge and intuition to be an authority on the voice of the customer, starting with internal stakeholders and then branching out to select direct relationships with affiliate stations and local news partners to deeply understand workflows and needs. Translate user insights into actionable product requirements and investment recommendations that connect partner needs to platform decisions. Partner with engineering and design to define, build, and ship product improvements with a consistent and high-quality delivery cadence. Define success metrics, ensure tracking is in place, and use data to validate impact, inform iteration, and communicate results to leadership. Leverage AI tools to accelerate product management workflows and evaluate where AI can meaningfully improve the team's speed and quality of output. About Goodyear

We’re dedicated to producing, innovating, and servicing the best tires in the world. For over 125 years, Goodyear has led the way in developing smart solutions that shape the future of mobility. Today, we’re one global team united by bold thinking, relentless drive, and a passion to exceed expectations. If you’re ready to embrace change and make an impact in your career, let’s go.

Why This Role Matters

The Administration Specialist is a key enabler of the organization, ensuring the smooth and efficient delivery of office, finance, HR, and IT support activities. By managing critical administrative processes, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external partners, maintaining accurate records and compliance, and supporting employees throughout their lifecycle, this role ensures business continuity, enhances employee experience, and enables teams to focus on achieving strategic business objectives.

What You'll Do

• Manage end-to-end office administration activities, including incoming and outgoing correspondence, document preparation and filing, records management, archiving, courier services, and coordination of office supplies and equipment maintenance.
• Maintain accurate administrative records and asset inventories (company vehicles, mobile devices, IT equipment, and access cards), ensuring data integrity, regulatory compliance, and efficient office operations while liaising with external service providers and archiving partners.
• Act as the primary point of contact for internal employees, suppliers, and external service providers, managing day-to-day communications, coordinating information flow, responding to inquiries, supporting ad hoc requests, and facilitating effective collaboration between vendors, finance, accounting, and other business functions.
• Support financial operations by managing quotation requests, creating and maintaining purchase orders and goods receipts, uploading contracts, processing and approving invoices, and coordinating with vendors, Finance, and FIE to ensure accurate invoicing and timely payments.
• Support HR administration by coordinating employee documentation, tax-related records, compliance requests, and ad hoc HR processes, while serving as a liaison with HR teams, TMF, and external stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely employee data management.
• Facilitate a seamless employee lifecycle experience by supporting onboarding and offboarding activities, including equipment and company car administration, medical examinations and HSE training coordination, new hire integration, exit procedures, and employee engagement initiatives such as team events and welcome/farewell activities.
• Provide first-line local IT coordination and user support by managing mobile and IT equipment lifecycle activities, including device procurement, subscription administration, equipment handovers, repairs and replacements, troubleshooting operational issues, and coordinating with external technology providers and network specialists.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Human Resources, Finance, or a related field.
• 2-4 years of experience in Office Administration, Executive/Administrative Support, Office Management, or a similar operational support role.
• Fluency in English (written and spoken), with the ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and regional teams.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills, with experience managing documentation, records, archiving, office operations, and multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Good financial administration knowledge, including purchase orders (POs), invoice processing, vendor coordination, contract administration, and basic accounting support activities.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams; experience with ERP/procurement systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Ariba, or similar) is an advantage.
• Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, combined with a proactive mindset, strong attention to detail, discretion in handling confidential information, and the ability to work independently.

We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every listed qualification, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description: The Luna Streaming Instance Provisioning Service (SIPS) team is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team of engineers responsible for the critical control-plane systems that power Amazon's cloud gaming platform. SIPS sits at the heart of the game streaming stack, owning streaming capacity and infrastructure, customer routing, session management, and queuing systems that work together to connect customers to the right streaming resources with high availability and low latency. As the Software Development Manager for SIPS, you will own the technical direction, execution, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems responsible for managing the end-to-end streaming session lifecycle. This includes determining where customer sessions should be routed, allocating and managing GPU-based compute capacity across AWS regions, orchestrating streaming sessions, and managing customer queues when capacity is constrained. You will lead the evolution of intelligent routing and capacity management systems that make real-time decisions based on customer location, latency, capacity availability, game requirements, infrastructure health, and other signals. You will also drive improvements to session management and queuing mechanisms to provide a reliable customer experience during both normal operations and periods of high demand. The team operates large-scale GPU-based EC2 fleets across multiple AWS regions and plays a critical role in major game and product launches. You will partner closely with senior engineers and teams across Streaming, Game Publishing, AWS infrastructure, and EC2 to anticipate demand, improve fleet utilization, address infrastructure constraints, and ensure the platform can scale reliably as the business grows. This role provides an opportunity to solve challenging distributed-systems problems across routing, scheduling, capacity management, session orchestration, queuing, resiliency, and infrastructure automation. You will define the long-term technical roadmap for these systems while driving improvements in availability, scalability, operational efficiency, and infrastructure cost. As a people leader, you will hire, develop, and mentor engineers, establish strong engineering and operational practices, and create clear ownership across the team's services. The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with a solid technical background in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, large-scale scheduling or routing systems, and highly available customer-facing services. Key job responsibilities - Lead the SIPS engineering team responsible for critical streaming control-plane systems, including customer routing, session management, queuing, capacity management, and fleet infrastructure. - Own the technical vision, architecture, roadmap, and execution for highly available distributed systems supporting large-scale game streaming workloads. - Drive intelligent routing and session placement strategies using customer latency, capacity availability, game requirements, and infrastructure health to deliver a reliable and low-latency streaming experience. - Own session lifecycle and queuing systems, ensuring the platform scales effectively during demand spikes, capacity constraints, infrastructure failures, and major game launches. - Drive capacity planning, provisioning, allocation, and fleet utilization across GPU-based EC2 infrastructure while balancing customer experience, availability, and infrastructure cost. - Improve platform scalability, resiliency, automation, observability, and operational excellence, reducing manual operations and preventing recurring customer-impacting issues. - Partner with Streaming, Game Publishing, Product, EC2, and other AWS infrastructure teams to deliver cross-organizational initiatives and ensure capacity and infrastructure readiness for major launches. - Establish mechanisms and metrics for availability, latency, queue experience, capacity readiness, utilization, and operational health. - Hire, mentor, and develop engineers, establish clear ownership and strong engineering practices, and build a high-performing team capable of solving complex distributed systems and infrastructure challenges. About the team SIPS is a 9-member engineering team responsible for core control-plane systems that power Amazon's cloud gaming platform. The team owns customer routing, session management, queuing, capacity management, and fleet infrastructure, enabling reliable and low-latency game streaming at scale. We solve complex distributed systems and infrastructure challenges across scalability, availability, capacity efficiency, and cost optimization. SIPS works closely with Streaming, Game Publishing, Product, EC2, and other AWS infrastructure teams to support major launches and continuously improve the customer streaming experience.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're hiring a strategist to join the Policy Campaigns team within Anthropic's Public Policy team. The Policy Campaigns team turns the company's policy priorities into active campaigns: research and polling, messaging, coalitions, paid media, and external execution. We're hiring a strategist to develop and execute paid media campaign strategy, manage agencies, and measure the success of our advocacy campaigns in the US and in priority markets abroad.

This is a strategy and program management role. You'll decide what a campaign needs to accomplish, who needs to hear from us, which messages and tactics will move them, and then implement accordingly. Anthropic works on many policy issues at once, across many markets, and you'll need to understand the full set of issues and find the right cross-cutting approaches to advance our goals. You'll direct the agencies that produce and place the work, and bring Policy, Communications, Marketing, Public Affairs, and Legal to agreement on tight legislative timelines.

The role also carries a substantial project management load. You'll run several campaigns at once, across time zones and agencies, and keep each one on schedule and on budget. You'll report to the Head of Policy Campaigns.

• Design paid and digital campaign strategies for legislative and policy goals, including objectives, audiences, messaging, tactics, phasing, and budget
• Develop campaign messaging and tactics with the Campaigns team, executives, Public Affairs, and Communications, and make sure paid media carries the core message
• Spot where a campaign could conflict with Anthropic's other policy, commercial, or international priorities, and resolve those tensions before launch
• Direct creative and media-buying agencies: set strategy and briefs, scopes and budgets, hold timelines, and hold the work to a high standard
• Run several campaigns at once across time zones and agencies: own the timelines, workplans, budgets, and status reporting, and keep partners in the US and abroad aligned

• Experience managing creative and media-buying agencies, including briefs, scopes, budgets, and performance reviews
• Experience running campaigns aimed at policymakers, key opinion formers, or other influential audiences
• Experience managing several campaigns or projects at once, with multiple agencies and stakeholders in different time zones
• Experience building campaign reporting in spreadsheets or dashboards

Preferred qualifications

• Experience managing state or federal legislative campaigns

We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time.
